narrative: On the board. The last leaf of the foul papers, at the lodging desk. One prose line stands under a blank where the two notes were fair-copied onto the leaves he will carry, not onto this one. His hand is off the page. His face is not over it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the line back and did not add a song beneath it.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on draft in One prose line
